mentions.name: Simulation-focused Minecraft competitor
mentions.description: A multiplayer Minecraft-style game built on a custom engine, centered on simulation and economics: autonomous towns with real economies that grow on their own and that players can trade and interact with, combined with interweaving progression systems. The foundation is complete, the game is multiplayer ready, and it loads in under 200MB.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A Minecraft competitor.

I'm leaning heavily on simulation, economics, towns with real economies, and interweaving progression systems. It's a custom engine. I finally have the foundation built, it's multiplayer ready, and it currently loads in under 200MB. The idea is to be hyper efficient to simulate multiple towns that grow by themselves and you can trade and interact with.
